note: No member. An owner admits a party, not a KeyPackage: naming who is meant is what lets the recipient refuse a KeyPackage for somebody else.
No host. Admission advances the room's epoch at its host; a recipient asked to guess where would be keeping a hosting register it must not keep.
A KeyPackage in standard base64 with padding. The family carries MLS messages as base64url without padding, and accepting both would give one KeyPackage two spellings.
A Welcome in the request. The recipient produces the Welcome; a caller supplying one is asking it to deliver group secrets it did not create.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
